# Introduction

This demonstration report summarizes a \gls{PK} analysis of theophylline
concentrations from the built-in `Theoph` dataset [@boeckmann1994],
rendered end to end through quartifyr's two-pass shell/fill pipeline.

{{< pagebreak >}}

# Results

## Summary Statistics

{{< appendix "StatisticalMethods" "Statistical Methods" >}}

Per-participant summary statistics were computed directly from the observed
concentration-time data; no model-based estimation (e.g. the nonlinear
mixed-effects approach in [@pinheiro1995]) was performed for this
demonstration report. See {{< appendix_crossref "StatisticalMethods" >}}
for the complete methodology.

{{< pagebreak >}}

<!-- Deliberate trailing sentence, not decorative: pandoc's docx writer
     puts an entire fenced code block in one giant paragraph (line breaks
     are `<w:br/>` runs, not separate `<w:p>` elements), and this script
     literally contains its own output filenames (e.g. "conc-time.png")
     as R code -- reportifyr's alt-text magic-string scan matches on that
     substring text, not just real `{rpfy}:` prefixes, and crashes
     (`XPathEvalError: Undefined namespace prefix`) if the match is the
     very last paragraph before the closing bookmarkEnd/sectPr, the same
     "trailing magic string" failure mode as ending a section on a real
     `{rpfy}:` line -- see the repo's reportifyr-integration-gotchas
     notes. End every appendix that embeds source code with a real
     sentence after the code block for this reason. -->
